newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Comercial del Plata yr net $36.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Comercial del Plata yr net $36.3 mln.

text.p: Period to December 31. Net $36.3 million vs $41.6 million.
NOTE: Oil, gas and utilities conglomerate Sociedad Comercial del Plata SA did not report per share, revenue or quarterly figures.
The company said that in December 1996 its net worth stood at $366 million.
The company said it was proposing the distribution of a dividend in shares of $1.7434 per share, equivalent to 17.43 percent of its outstanding capital.
Separately, its fuel subsidiary Compania General de Combustibles SA (CGC) announced it posted a year net of $54.3 million. The previous year it had posted a $23.66 million net.
CGC net worth stood at $300 million in December 31.
